# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(`.fah/memory/note/` since gh-2185 — local-only, not committed; the
user's files: read freely, write only via `memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/goldens/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/goldens` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);
  releases go DRAFT-first and publish at `release-provenance` only with
  signed SHA256SUMS attached. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only (`## Unreleased`).
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag (first publish of a new
  package is manual); every lockfile is committed and enforced
  (`scripts/check_lockfiles.sh`); TestFlight external-group + store
  pipelines have required repo variables.

Full text: `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`.

## Bench

Bench knobs (agent timeouts, stall/watch, `FA_CONN_DEBUG`, hang replay,
report semantics) → `docs/bench.md` (round-3 knobs: issue #1392).

## Docs index

`docs/README.md` indexes every canonical doc (agents/, memory-churn,
compaction, dap, cubes, redaction, hep, ci, bench, browser-extension,
outlook-addin, …). New docs must be listed there.

NO → keep. So the pinned line survives either way in this fixture. Still passes with the transfer-side protection dropped. So the pinned-line assertion isn't pining the protection. Why isn't the line marked?

Hypothesis: the line never gets GRADED — where does the pinned line sit in the transfer? After the ask bullets, before '## Hand-over'. The belt's `_beltSectionBody` grades bullet blocks AND prose lines... but wait: after the last bullet block ('- what was the exact error?'), `_bulletBlockEnd(lines, i)` — a bullet BLOCK may swallow the following non-bullet continuation lines! `- what was the exact error?\nrun the failover drill...` — the drill line is treated as part of the previous bullet's block (continuation), and the whole block contains the protected... no wait, protection is off in the mutation. The block content: 'what was the exact error? run the failover drill every Monday at 09:00.' → flat; contained in userTexts? `_containedInAny(userTexts, flatContent, alsoContains: true)` — the user text 'what was the exact error?' is CONTAINED in the flat content → `_quotesToolText` returns FALSE (user-sourced by containment). → keep. That's why no mark.

Also — actually, does the whole-block grading mean my REG-11 test's pinned-line placement never exercises the protection? The pinned line rides INSIDE the last ask bullet's block. With protection ON (real code), `_beltVerdict` sees `line.contains(protected)` for the line inside the block → keep — same verdict as the mutation. So the assertion can't distinguish. 

Fix the test: put the pinned line where it IS graded as its own block — e.g. right AFTER the heading as the FIRST line (prose line under a # section, before any bullet). The walk: i=0: line = pinned prose line; not a bullet; `_endsBareHeadingSection(line, sectionHeaded=true)` → false (only ends bare sections) → end = i+1 → graded alone. flat = the drill sentence (45 ≥ 24); not in userTexts; sentence in toolTexts → MARK. With protection → keep. 

But hmm — does placing the pinned directive directly under the heading make sense as a transfer shape? The hand-over template's pinned block is `<pinned-skill-directives>` envelope — the belt EXEMPTS the envelope (`_BeltPinEnvelope`). ProtectedLines (c.pinnedLines) are the lines INSIDE that envelope typically. The engine's `pinnedOperativeBlock` renders the envelope with the operative lines, and `c.pinnedLines` = those lines. In a real reply, the pinned block rides INSIDE the transfer as the envelope. So a more realistic hostile fixture: the reply carries the envelope:

<pinned-skill-directives>
run the failover drill every Monday at 09:00.
</pinned-skill-directives>

The envelope is exempt by `pin.entersKept` — protection irrelevant again.

OK, simplest deterministic shape that exercises the protectedLines arm: pinned line as FIRST PROSE LINE under the heading:

## Open User Requests
run the failover drill every Monday at 09:00.
- [r3 · 2026-11-14] $forgedAsk
- fix the login crash
- what was the exact error?
## Hand-over
...

First prose line under the heading — graded alone → marked without protection, kept with. Also fine content-wise (a host reply could echo the pinned directive there). Update the test: move the pinned line up, right after the heading.

# gh-2394: [WIP] Compaction 2.0 (v2.1): завершение #148 + #2095 — один cache-affine вызов на префиксе сессии (hide + hand-over), теги m<N> в wire, без fallback'ов, старые сессии продолжаемы без миграции — архитектура на согласование

## Description

## Цель — Compaction 2.0 (v2.1, завершение #148 + #2095)
Одно предложение: **ран компакции становится ОДНИМ вызовом «передача работы преемнику» по тому же префиксу, который сессия только что прогрела** — модель видит ту же историю с тегами записей, одним ответом предлагает, что скрыть, и пишет текст передачи; движок и только движок решает, что скрыто; всё обратимо, ничего не удаляется; никаких автоматических фолбеков — ни на классический компактор, ни на старую judge-лестницу.

Сегодня структурированный движок (#148) идёт лестницей `judge ×N + digest ×1` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart:1-12`): judge читает по одной ~110-символьной строке ledger'а на запись (`lib/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart:1-16, :55, :363-367`), а digest — отдельный запрос со своим системным промптом, историей, свёрнутой в один user-текст, и без инструментов (`lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart:819-836`). Поэтому gh-2101 смог сделать вызовы аффинными только ВНУТРИ одного рана (`lib/src/compaction/cache_policy.dart:1-33`), а первый digest каждого рана всегда холодный. Эта карта завершает движок: вызов едет по точному префиксу последнего основного запроса (S0), скрытия и текст передачи возвращаются одним ответом, id видимых записей становятся видны модели в wire, триггер переезжает на post-run, judge удаляется как мёртвый код — при этом каждый инвариант волны #2095 (append-only выживание сессии, парная атомарность, user-ходы неприкосновенны для HIDE, failure-safety) остаётся верным.

Этот документ — архитектурный, для чтения owner'ом перед любой реализацией. Он заменяет WIP-тело issue и консолидирует всё по компакции: #148, волну #2095, смежные и закрытые карты. Версия 2.1 — после независимого ревью (проверка каждой несущей цитаты по исходникам) и раунда решений owner'а 2026-11-25. Все file:line перечитаны в исходниках на момент написания; всё непроверенное помечено «закрепить при реализации».

## Почему такая рамка
- **Отозвано: «Compaction 2.0 = построить структурированный движок».** Это было #148, и оно отправлено (hide-проход, checkpoint-проход, маркеры, `compact_expand`). Эта карта — не третий движок, а завершение первого; `compaction.engine: classic` — только выбор пользователя в настройках (`engine.dart:15-23`, `lib/src/compaction/compaction_engine.dart:18-25`).
- **Отозвано: «digest по текущей проекции».** Скрытия применяются первыми и выбирают старые записи — digest по post-hide проекции промахнулся бы по тёплому кэшу с первой скрытой записи. Вызов читает снимок ДО скрытий: последний отправленный основной запрос (S0).
- **Отозвано: вторая очередь скрытий в ответе.** ОДИН список; остаточное давление — не второй вызов в том же ране, а гистерезис + жёсткий guard (D8).
- **Отозвано: отдельный judge.** Один вызов видит полные записи (S0) — «этот bash-вывод superseded?» решается по содержимому, а не по превью. Judge-код удаляется (D1).
- **Отозвано (раунд 2): любые автоматические фолбеки** — на classic prefix compactor и на judge-лестницу («фолбеки прячут проблемы»). Устойчивость merged-вызова — лесенка в том же вызове (D1), а не смена движка.

## История и дрейф — что дали #148 и волна #2095, где уехало

### Что доставлено
- **#148 — структурированный движок.** Hide-проход = LLM-judge по context ledger (одна типизированная строка на видимую запись); checkpoint-проход = digest по старейшему скрываемому диапазону; однострочные маркеры на прежней позиции, раскрываются через `compact_expand` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/expand_tool.dart:56`); парные группы скрываются атомарно (D6, `ledger.dart:77-80`); реальные user-ходы `·exempt` и не могут быть СКРЫТЫ никогда (F8/F9, `ledger.dart:13-16, :62`) и сворачиваются в checkpoint вместе со своим диапазоном (уже сегодня — ✗A ревью); неудачный проход НЕ дописывает ничего (`engine.dart:15-23`). Скрытия — аппенды `HiddenRangeRecord` (`lib/src/session/session_record.dart:530`), чекпоинты — `CompactCheckpointRecord` (`:554`).
- **Достроено по ходу:** #287 (2.0 по умолчанию, classic — выбор в настройках), #266 (agent-UX: маркеры + превью + запрос скрытых), #1379 (agent-initiated hide, LRU re-hide, pin сегмента), #541 (judge — единая точка отказа → детерминированный fallback + бюджет; вход judge ограничен 512 записями, `ledger.dart:88-97`), #387/#388 (никогда не выше max-window; keep-recent пол; консолидация маркеров), #1425 (fold'ы resume-эквивалентны), #1409 (pinned skill lines переживают fold), #2044 (fragile-band escalation — один углубляющий проход), #1131/#1219 (санитайзер эфемерных claims; эпистемический статус в summaries), #85/#86 (парная целостность), #740/#1085 (компакция не brick'ает сессию; нет молчания после компакции).
- **#2095 — эпик «Auto-compact overhaul»** (открыт; дети закрыты). Что каждый дал и что от него нужно v2.1:
  - **#2096 judge robustness** — cross-run health latch (`judge_health.dart`), бюджет на вызов, диагностика таймаутов. *Для v2.1:* latch уходит вместе с judge (D1); бюджет попытки остаётся и ограничивает merged-вызов (`compaction.judgeBudgetSeconds` → `attemptBudget`, `compaction_engine.dart:63-81`, `agent_cli_compaction.dart:973`).
  - **#2097 honest measurement** — ре-якорь состояния на старте рана (`_refreshState`, `engine.dart:359`), честный отчёт, sid в логах. *Для v2.1:* теги входят в базу давления (D14); S0 — «как отправлено», база не перевыворачивается посреди рана.
  - **#2098 configurable trigger** — секция `compaction:`, `triggerRatio`/`reserveTokens`/`keepRecentTokens` (`lib/src/compaction/tuning.dart:41-102`, `docs/compaction.md:33`). *Для v2.1:* новые ключи `softRatio`, `handOver.maxTokens`, `handOver.hysteresisTurns` ложатся туда же.
  - **#2099 two-tier engine** — emergency-уровень mid-turn без LM (`EmergencyRelief`, `lib/src/compaction/emergency_relief.dart:1-9`); quality-уровень на границе хода (`docs/compaction.md:154-201`). *Для v2.1:* merged-вызов — quality-уровень на post-run; emergency-уровень не трогается.
  - **#2100 working-set re-injection** — obligations-блок + working-set-блок с goal-слотом, хвостовые сообщения проекции, не записи сессии (`session_tree.dart:768-834`, `docs/compaction.md:290-310`). *Для v2.1:* хвостовые блоки байт-идентичны до/после fold'а (I2) и никогда не тегируются.
  - **#2101 cache-aware calls** — один run-scoped routing id на ран, `short` retention, метрики прохода; id намеренно ≠ id сессии (`docs/compaction.md:203-233`, `cache_policy.dart:23-26`). *Для v2.1:* `affine` остаётся для standalone digest; целью становится корзина самой сессии (`sessionAffine`).
  - **#2102 /handoff** — свежая сессия из редактируемого digest'а (`lib/src/compaction/handoff_digest.dart`). *Для v2.1:* инструкция «передача работы» — внутрисессионный родственник /handoff.
  - **#2103 provenance audit** — summaries не отмывают tool-текст в доверенную память; `sanitizeSummary` + `SummaryOriginEvidence` (`lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:1-31, :56-87, :151-198`). *Для v2.1:* текст передачи проходит через этот же gate при persist — и gate реально срабатывает (N1 → D2).
- **Epic, жёсткое ограничение — сохраняем дословно:** "Session survival: multi-GB sessions must survive every change in this epic. All session writes stay append-only/additive (new record kinds, hidden ranges, markers); no migration may rewrite, replace, or re-encode existing session files (legacy does not "back up and replace"); every session-touching card's acceptance includes a fixture proving an old session loads unchanged (byte-identical apart from the new additive records)."

- **PR #**: 2407

## PR Description

## Summary

Compaction 2.0 v2.1 (GOAL #2394, finishing #148 + #2095): the post-run fold becomes ONE **merged hand-over call** on the session's own model.

- **Record tags + S0** — every request under the structured engine prefixes each projected record with its file alias `m<N> ` (epoch rule: the live edge past the last record stays untagged); the agent loop captures each main request as sent (`RequestSnapshot`, invalidated on model switch or when a run appends records).
- **Cache-affine routing** — `compaction.cacheRetention`, `CompactionCachePolicy.sessionAffine()`, `StreamCacheRouting`/`StreamCallShape`: the hand-over call resends S0's prefix byte-for-byte with NULL tool choice, the session model's `maxTokens`, Anthropic's history breakpoint on the last user turn.
- **Hand-over protocol** — `prompts/compaction/hand_over.md` (+ gen spec), `parseHandOverReply`, `sanitizeHideLabel`, `renderHandOverInstruction`, `verifyOpenUserRequests`, the call adapter with its robustness ladder (nudge on a tool-call reply, transient retry, `length` → 2× budget, exhausted → nothing appended + loud failure).
- **Engine merged pass** (`structured/engine_hand_over.dart`, `hand_over_dispose.dart`) — the ENGINE disposes the hide proposals (pair snap, user turns never hidden, unknown/in-range/covered/tail ignored, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S), labels are sanitized and stored ONLY in the additive `labels` field of a consolidated `hidden_range`, the transfer text is sanitized with the S0 origin evidence + pinned lines and persisted as a tail-layout checkpoint whose `## Open User Requests` section is verified against the mechanical asks block. No fallbacks on the merged path: the judge, the digest ladder and the classic compactor are never reached.
- **Markers** — ONE consolidated marker per range at its carrier (`<label> [expand a-b]`), untagged fold pointer, transfer record at its own position with the tagged hidden index; `isCompactionMarkerText` resolves old + new forms.
- **Mode table** (`compaction_mode.dart`) — engine × S0 validity × separate digest role → classic / merged / standalone, decided up front.
- **Trigger** — post-run soft line (`compaction.softRatio`, default hard − 5 %), hysteresis `compaction.handOver.hysteresisTurns` (default 3), `compacting` gate queueing prompts (CLI + Flutter); pre-flight stays hard-only. Keys: `compaction.handOver.maxTokens` (default 8192).
- **Old sessions** — no migration; legacy records render as before, the first compaction after resume is a merged call over the old chain, `session_search` / `/handoff` / `fa session list` unchanged; the file is only appended to.

Branch history: a local BSD-time fix for #2404 (commit `577dc8d916`) was superseded by main's #2406 when `origin/main` was merged in (`e9af81acc0` wins for `test/scripts/load_drop_retry_test.dart` and `scripts/load_drop_retry.sh`; no diff vs `main` on those files).

Open review threads (`pr_discussions.md` / `pr_discussions_raw.json`), 2. Merge conflicts (`merge_conflicts.md`), or 3. Owned CI failures (`ci_failures.md` / `ci_violations.json` / `ci_classification.json`). - **DO NOT** refactor, reformat, rename, reorganize imports, or rewrite untouched/already-approved parts of the PR diff (even if your session started fresh without prior history). - Keep the rework commit diff minimal and strictly scoped to the open findings so reviewers can verify each fix in isolation. ## tdd_approach.md ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue

— do not expand scope beyond the reported issue"] T3["REFACTOR: Clean up while keeping tests GREEN

Write failing unit tests in the repository's existing unit-test tree **only**:

- Discover the unit-test directory from the existing build and test configuration and from nearby tests for the code being changed.
- Follow the naming, layout, and test-runner conventions already established in that directory.

❌ **Never** place development TDD tests under `testing/`.
`testing/` is owned by test-automation agents (regression probes, workflow observation tests, accessibility gates, etc.). If your production changes break existing tests there, leave them untouched and mention the breakage in `outputs/response.md` so the test-automation agent can update them.


## git_completion_guard.md
# Git Completion & Closing-Keyword Guard

- **Completion guard**: Before writing `outputs/response.md`, run `git fetch origin && git log "origin/$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref origin/HEAD | cut -d/ -f2)..HEAD" --oneline`. An empty result means your commits did not land — re-do or resume the work before declaring completion.
- **No closing keywords in commits or PR bodies**: Do NOT include `Fixes #...`, `Closes #...`, or `Resolves #...` against tracker tickets unless explicitly instructed; ticket lifecycle transitions are managed by the post-action workflow.


## formatting_rules.md
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    F1["outputs/response.md must be Markdown (# headings, - bullets, ``` code fences)"]
    F2["Required sections: ## Issues/Notes (if any), ## Approach, ## Files Modified, ## Test Coverage"]
    F3["Be surgical but thorough — fix exact issues flagged, then check same pattern across codebase"]
    F4["Do NOT refactor unrelated code or add unrequested features"]
    F5["When open PR review threads exist, create outputs/review_replies/*.md files and reference them from outputs/review_replies.json"]
```

- When `input/<TICKET>/pr_discussions_raw.json` contains open PR review threads:
  - Write one Markdown file per open thread under `outputs/review_replies/`.
  - Write `outputs/review_replies.json` with one entry per open thread, including `inReplyToId`, `threadId`, and a `reply` field that contains the path to the matching `.md` file.
  - Do **not** put reply bodies inline in the JSON.

Rework posts **only** to the Pull Request. All output must be Markdown.

# PR #2407 Rework — response

## Issues/Notes

No CI failures were open (`ci_failures.md`: "No Failed Checks") and `ci_classification.json` does not exist — nothing to own or dispute there.

All 13 open review threads are answered in `outputs/review_replies.json` (one entry per thread, `outputs/review_replies/thread_N.md` bodies):

| # | Thread | Severity | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOGg` S0 invalidation gaps | 🚨 BLOCKING | **fixed** |
| 2 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOIY` gate/belt heading divergence | 🚨 BLOCKING | **fixed** |
| 3 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOJ-` `CompactingGate.run` unregistered join | ⚠️ IMPORTANT | **fixed** |
| 4 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOLY` verbatim-asks normalization one-sided | ⚠️ IMPORTANT | **fixed** |
| 5 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rONs` no hostile-text persist-site test | ⚠️ IMPORTANT | **fixed** |
| 6 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOPu` D9/AC12/E21 host wirings untested | ⚠️ IMPORTANT | **fixed** |
| 7 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOR5` tuning keys CLI-only | ⚠️ IMPORTANT | **fixed** |
| 8 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOTO` `[expand]` end-anchor | 💡 SUGGESTION | not picked (same-files-only) — triage |
| 9 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOU2` classic tag-leak assert | 💡 SUGGESTION | not picked (same-files-only) — triage |
| 10 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOWJ` `x-initiator` unasserted | 💡 SUGGESTION | not picked (same-files-only) — triage |
| 11 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOX0` IT-10 tail | 💡 SUGGESTION | partially covered (`isCompactionMarkerText` forms); rest — triage |
| 12 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOZ2` ladder rung (b) success path | 💡 SUGGESTION | not picked (same-files-only) — triage |
| 13 | `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOcJ` barrel sort order | 🪶 NIT | not picked (scope guard: untouched file) — triage |

Every 🚨/⚠️ thread (the approval-gating tiers per `review_policy.md`) is fixed with a regression test. The 💡/🪶 threads that were not picked up are all outside the files the mandatory set touches — per the opportunistic rules (`opportunisticSameFilesOnly: true`) they stay for machine triage; each reply names the exact one-line follow-up triage needs. No downgrades were applied.

## Approach

TDD per thread (RED → GREEN): each fix landed with a test that reproduces the finding first.

- **T1 (S0 staleness)** — one invalidation in `Agent.reset()` covers every projection-replacing reset caller (session switch, resume, `/handoff`, app session load); rewind invalidates in the checkpoint tool; the CLI post-run invalidation became unconditional (a ladder kill can land after the records were appended); both hosts' relief paths invalidate after re-anchoring.
- **T2 (gate/belt divergence)** — the mandatory-section gate now requires the belt's exact heading shape (`#{1,6}\s+`), so a reply that would blind the belt fails the gate before anything is appended.
- **T3 (gate join)** — a joined `CompactingGate.run` body re-registers as the active compaction before executing, so `isCompacting`/`wait()` hold for the whole joined run.
- **T4 (asks normalization)** — `verifyOpenUserRequests` normalizes both sides identically (record-tag strip, zero-width/noise reduction, whitespace collapse).
- **T5 (hostile persist test)** — `REG-11`/`E36b`/`E36` regressions at the real persist site; both mutation-checked (`origins:` and `protectedLines:` dropped → test fails).
- **T6 (host wiring tests)** — CLI lifecycle tests + the app session-load test + the E2E-04/IT-19 prompt-during-post-run gate test.
- **T7 (tuning parity)** — the app parses `compaction:` through the CLI's own strict parser and feeds `resolveCompactionHostWiring`; `sameResolutionAs` compares the three hand-over knobs, so one-sided tuning fails the parity assertion in both directions.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/agent/agent.dart`, `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — S0 invalidation on reset/rewind (T1)
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart` — unconditional post-run invalidation + relief invalidation (T1, T6)
- `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_compaction.dart`, `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart` — app mirrors + tuning wiring (T1, T6, T7)
- `lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart` — gate join re-registration (T3)
- `lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart` — heading regex + asks normalization (T2, T4)
- `lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart` — parity compares the hand-over knobs (T7)
- `lib/src/config/app_config_sections.dart` — app `compaction:` section parsing (T7)
- Tests: `test/agent/agent_test.dart`, `test/tools/checkpoint_tool_test.dart`, `test/compaction/hand_over_test.dart`, `test/compaction/hand_over_trigger_test.dart`, `test/compaction/hand_over_pass_test.dart`, `test/cli/agent_cli_merged_s0_lifecycle_test.dart`, `test/config/app_config_sections_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/agent_service_session_load_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/agent_service_compaction_it_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/compaction_host_wiring_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/agent_service_app_config_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/agent_service_test.dart`

## Test Coverage

- `test/compaction test/config` (dart): **939 passed** — includes the T2/T3/T4/T5/T7 regressions.
- `test/agent/agent_test.dart`, `test/tools/checkpoint_tool_test.dart`, `test/compaction/hand_over_test.dart`, `test/compaction/hand_over_trigger_test.dart`, `test/compaction/request_snapshot_test.dart`, `test/cli/agent_cli_merged_s0_lifecycle_test.dart`: **103 passed** (T1/T3/T6).

- `dart analyze` on the touched packages: no issues; `flutter analyze` on the touched app files: no new findings.
- Mutation checks: dropping `origins:` or `protectedLines:` at the persist-site `sanitizeSummary` fails `REG-11`; dropping the hysteresis knob from `sameResolutionAs` fails the parity test in both directions.

## Foreign / infra reds

None — CI reported no failed checks at leg start.

# Thread PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOR5 — `compaction:` tuning keys honored only on the CLI

**Fixed** (commit `9173605b28`).

- `lib/src/config/app_config_sections.dart` — the app loader parses the `compaction:` section through the SAME strict CLI parser (`CompactionTuning.fromSection`, user scope): a bad section warns and falls back to the defaults (AC7), siblings are never poisoned.
- `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart` — the parsed tuning rides `_compactionTuning` (set once at initialize) into `_compactionWiring`.
- `lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart` — `sameResolutionAs` now compares `handOverMaxTokens`, `handOverHysteresisTurns` and `softRatio`, so one-sided tuning fails the merge-blocking parity assertion.

Tests: `test/config/app_config_sections_test.dart` (4 parsing/AC7 cases), `flutter_app/test/compaction_host_wiring_test.dart` (both paths resolve equal wirings from one tuning; hysteresis drift on one host fails `sameResolutionAs` in BOTH directions), `flutter_app/test/agent_service_app_config_test.dart` (yaml section → resolved app wiring; absent section → null entries).
===
# Thread PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc67rOX0 — IT-10 tail coverage (LRU-before-merged, no-second-call, compact_expand)

**Partially addressed; the rest left for triage.**

Already covered: `compact_expand` / `isCompactionMarkerText` on the new forms — `test/compaction/hand_over_pass_test.dart`, `AC9/UT-26 marker forms` group asserts every new form (`[expand N]`, `[expand N-M]`, tagged/untagged, label variants) matched and every near-miss (unterminated, non-numeric, mid-sentence quote) rejected.

Not covered and not picked up in this lap: the LRU-before-merged ordering and the no-second-merged-call rule live in `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart`'s tier orchestration, which the mandatory set did not touch (same-files-only rule). The same file (`hand_over_pass_test.dart`) did gain the second-range/second-call coverage that exists (`second.run(force: true)` path, line ~620).
